name: kriah-listener
description: A classroom Hebrew reading station that hears a child read and marks every letter and vowel.

scripts.build: npm --prefix station ci && npm --prefix station run build -- --configLoader native
scripts.phonemes:setup: python3 -m venv phonemes/.venv && phonemes/.venv/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir -r phonemes/requirements.txt && phonemes/.venv/bin/python -I phonemes/server.py --download
scripts.test:station: cd station && npx vitest run --configLoader native
